arguments.title: Putting the Object Back into Video Object Segmentation
key_claims: Object-level memory complements local pixel matching to improve coherent video object masks. This supports testing propagation from fixed SAM2 initialization against independent per-frame SAM2, with identical initial prompts. The paper documents failures for similar objects occluding or approaching one another; coach identity and foreground leakage therefore need independent masks. A segmentation benchmark gain is not a color-observer gain. Test retained-background HS error directly, not just mask smoothness or IoU, and reset at declared shot boundaries.
